date.description: Calendar date represented by the measurements.

searches.description: Total searches on the date, or null when the upstream series has no value for the date.

searchesWithoutResults.description: Searches returning no products on the date, or null when unavailable.

clicks.description: Product clicks originating from searches on the date, or null when unavailable.

averageClickPosition.description: Average position of clicked products on the date, or null when unavailable.

conversions.description: Conversions attributed to searches on the date, or null when unavailable.

description: Search Analytics measurements for one date in the requested period.
